up: Retrieve a list of all approved drugs indicated for HIV infection. For each drug, return the ChEMBL ID, the drug name, the canonical SMILES, the EFO ID associated with the indication, the EFO term (indication label), and the maximum phase for that specific indication.
sql:
WITH hiv_drugs AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    di.molregno,
    di.efo_id AS efo_id,
    di.efo_term AS indication_label,
    di.max_phase_for_ind
  FROM drug_indication di
  WHERE di.mesh_heading = 'HIV Infections'
    AND di.max_phase_for_ind = 4
)
SELECT
  md.chembl_id,
  md.pref_name AS drug_name,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  hd.efo_id,
  hd.indication_label,
  hd.max_phase_for_ind AS max_phase
FROM hiv_drugs hd
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON hd.molregno = md.molregno
LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON hd.molregno = cs.molregno;
